EMPLOYEE PAYSLIP

A quick start to payday

  1. Build your team. Add employees or import the 10-column CSV from your repository.
  2. Review the numbers. Salary components, PF, professional tax, and illustrative TDS are calculated automatically.
  3. Create your payslips. Open a payslip for a full breakdown, then download it or export a payroll summary.

This app prepares payroll calculations. It does not transfer money. The hosted demo calculates in your browser; run the included Java adapter to use the original Java classes.
